paragraphs: I'm applying for the Associate Director of Data Analytics role at the School of Environmental and Biological Sciences. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role sits with the finance dean and covers enrollment, budgeting and resource allocation, which is where my analytics and finance work overlap.

At Lenovo I defined the requirements and did the QA for AI-powered dashboards with real-time metrics, which saved 4+ hours a week of reporting, and I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. At JPMorgan I turned large datasets into reporting and dashboards for senior leadership on budget allocation across marketing channels.
Building dashboards and reports that deans and department heads can use for planning and program review is the kind of work I've done, in a new setting. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
